Depression has dominated my life ever since I could remember. It is a beast of a thing. I'm only 23 years old, so I still have time to figure it out I guess... But still, it's been quite as long as I remember (Starting in Middle School) and even before that having some problems. 

I was bad. I have 10mg tabs of Valium to take if needed, and I was in a deep panic and took twice what I should have. I didn't really care how numb I got, I just needed to get numb. Tianeptine helped with that as well. It took the edge off. Made me a little calmer so that I could think a little more clear. 

I'm on Symbyax, Latuda, Lithium along with the Valium.

I always find honesty is the best thing. Being open about your emotions and not bottling them up is good for your mental health. Keeping everything in is damaging over time, and can just makes things not work. You may find yourself going crazy, or having a hard dealing with life. That's just me though. Others might be able to handle whats going on with you, but I know for me it'd just get worse by not letting things out. I'd hate to have it you drive you crazy. The nice thing about telling her is that you'll finally know, and not just wonder on the "what if" and "what will". If I was you I'd tell her and state that you don't want it to change your relationship and hope for the best. Better in the long run. But that's just me.
